supersedes.reason: Identical recipe stored in float16 instead of bfloat16. FP16 keeps 97.8% of the merged LoRA delta against BF16's 82.8% at the same file size, scores 45/64 Showcase against A1's 43, matches 125/192 Stability, and reproduces the offline gate on 256/256 rows where A1 disagreed on 5.

public_claim: Single-pass Supa A-series core, float16 store: 45/64 Showcase (tuning-split checkpoint evaluation), 125/192 previously inspected Stability, 170/256 combined. Abstention is a constant logit offset, not a weight. Requires greedy decoding, float16 load, and trust_remote_code=True. No statistical significance is claimed. Sealed TEST does not exist and has not been run.

abstention.not_stored_in_weights: Qwen3's lm_head is nn.Linear(bias=False) with tied embeddings and no config flag for a head bias, so no checkpoint of this architecture can hold the constant. It is applied in forward, which is why this core needs trust_remote_code=True.
abstention.selection_status: POST-HOC gate, threshold selected on Showcase only; carried over unchanged from Supa-A1
abstention.loader_requirement: trust_remote_code=True. Without it the directory loads as plain Qwen3ForCausalLM with no gate and NO WARNING (121/192 instead of 125/192). Assert type(model).__name__ == 'Qwen3AbstainForCausalLM'.

statistical_position.summary: The abstention gate is worth a stable +4 (S4 form) to +7 (S1 form) on Stability across every numerical realisation tested. No configuration in this family is statistically distinguishable from any other, and the earlier S1 headline of 130/192 at p=0.0490 held only on the BF16 base+adapter arithmetic path.
statistical_position.power: At the observed effect the study has power 0.31 at n=192. Roughly 576 rows would be needed for 80% power.
statistical_position.effect_ci: S1 gate delta +7 rows, 95% paired-pack bootstrap CI [-1, +15]

caveats: No sealed TEST split exists for this suite; the corpus is 64 + 192 rows.
Stability192 has been read many times and is no longer a clean split.
The threshold is calibrated to this model only; on Rineya-Baya-1.7.0 the same gate lowers Showcase from 40 to 35.
Loading without trust_remote_code=True silently disables the gate.
Load in float16; a bfloat16 load re-rounds the weights and discards the precision this core exists to preserve.
